description.value: Comox Bike Company has been the Comox Valley's local bike shop since 1988, serving island riders across every trail network for over 35 years. An authorized retailer of Specialized, Santa Cruz, Cervélo, and Kona, they offer full sales, repair, professional bike fitting with 2DMA Motion Capture technology, and a premium rental fleet. Located a stone's throw from the Cumberland Trail Network and Forbidden Plateau, this is a natural stop for touring and trail cyclists on Vancouver Island.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: wall_loops (2 spaces) at 4m; rack (4 spaces) at 50m; rack (6 spaces) at 53m. Total: 12 spaces.
